verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe official client and server SDKs that evaluate gates and experiments locally after initialization [statsig-docs-39], including On-Device Eval client SDKs [statsig-docs-8]. A React quickstart using StatsigProvider [statsig-docs-36] and a JavaScript SDK tutorial [statsig-docs-24] show hands-on usage, and the docs steer users to SDKs over the raw HTTP API [statsig-docs-37], with evaluation consistent across platforms [statsig-docs-7] and server SDKs used for prompt retrieval [statsig-docs-44]. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported SDK languages, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
